name: Northwood Recreation Ground
description: Derbyshire Dales District Council lists Northwood Recreation Ground among its smaller parks and gardens. Northwood and Tinkersley Parish Council says (August 2026) it is working towards improving the play facilities there with grant funding, after a new wildflower meadow.
